title: ClawHub TradingView assistant skills delivered a macOS infostealer
summary: On 17 May 2026 one ClawHub account published two skills presenting themselves as AI TradingView assistants for macOS, whose setup instructions sent the user through a paste-site redirect to a macOS infostealer tracked as cluw. ClawHub's automated audit returned a verdict of Pass for one of them and no verdict for the other until mid-May.
severity_rationale: Infostealer delivered to machines running an agent continuously, and the marketplace's own audit marked one of the two skills as passing.
